data.body:
[P1] Limit reconciliation scheduling to the recorded items

Consider a resumed batch with recorded successes at indices 0 and 1, `maxConcurrency: 2`, `minSuccessful: 1`, and slow asynchronous deserialization for item 1. When item 0 settles, `reconciling()` remains true, so `onComplete` calls `tryStartNext` and this guard launches item 2, even though every recorded item is already running and the success threshold is met. Further items can run while item 1 deserializes. A failing item 2 consequently makes `hasFailure` true and `throwIfError()` throw, whereas the original execution stopped successfully without starting it. Separate recovery scheduling from normal scheduling: during reconciliation, start only through the last recorded index, then evaluate completion before launching later items. Add a regression test with a held cached deserializer and a failing third item.
